name: codelit-platform-workspace
description: Shared infrastructure packages and product bootstrap for CodeLit applications

scripts.test: bun run prepare:dist && bun run --workspaces --if-present test
scripts.typecheck: bun run prepare:dist && bun run --filter @codelitdev/billing typecheck && bun run --filter @codelitdev/oauth-server-kit check-types && bun run --filter @codelitdev/design-system check && bun run --filter @codelitdev/platform typecheck && bun run --filter @codelitdev/observability typecheck && bun run --filter @codelitdev/mcp-server-kit typecheck && bun run --filter @codelitdev/platform-preset typecheck && bun run --filter @codelitdev/platform-conformance typecheck && bun run --filter @codelitdev/platform-cli typecheck && bun run --filter @reference-product/api typecheck && bun run --filter @reference-product/web typecheck && bun run --filter @reference-product/api-contract typecheck
scripts.prepare:dist: bun run --filter @codelitdev/billing build && bun run --filter @codelitdev/oauth-server-kit build && bun run --filter @codelitdev/platform build && bun run --filter @codelitdev/observability build && bun run --filter @codelitdev/mcp-server-kit build && bun run --filter @codelitdev/platform-preset build && bun run --filter @codelitdev/platform-conformance build && bun run --filter @codelitdev/platform-cli build
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run --filter @reference-product/api check:drift && bun run test && bun run build && bun run test:packed
scripts.test:packed: bun run --filter @codelitdev/billing test:packed && bun run --filter @codelitdev/platform test:packed && bun run --filter @codelitdev/observability test:packed && bun run --filter @codelitdev/mcp-server-kit test:packed && bun run --filter @codelitdev/platform-preset test:packed && bun run --filter @codelitdev/platform-conformance test:packed && bun run --filter @codelitdev/platform-cli test:packed && bun scripts/check-package-contents.mjs
